exact_intentional_changes: Three added linked-frame controls (two table states and one hidden-wrapper case).
Rename mixed-blank case and remove only the synthetic empty text-box anchor from its expected paragraph/search sequence.
Extend helper to assert paragraphs and tables separately while retaining original read/search expectation.
For the one covered-cell fixture, assert paragraphs ['AB'] and table [[['Visible']]] while retaining text sequence AB\nVisible.

frame_expectations.contract_assessment: The exact fixture inverses support the report: original fixture XML and visible nonempty text were retained. Structured table ownership and the synthetic-empty-anchor behavior are deliberate contract decisions, not unchanged expectations. This audit does not establish runtime correctness.

retained_development_log_review.kind: Reconstruction of retained development logs only; this is not a new test execution or frozen-source qualification.

clarifications.subject: Namespace statement in frame-reconciliation.md
clarifications.detail: Frame and inline-story traversal checks namespace identity. The inherited top-level OfficeTextExtractor table/table-row/table-cell streaming dispatch still tests local names, so the unqualified sentence "Namespace identity is required" should be scoped to the frame/inline paths reviewed here.

clarifications.subject: UTF-8 separator budget statement in frame-reconciliation.md
clarifications.detail: Search/readOdfText charges emitted paragraph separators. Generic structured extraction charges decoded content and separators inside cells, while wrappers and block separators later added by OfficeTextExtract.plainString remain outside that budget, as OdfTextBudget already documents. Keep that distinction if describing the contract broadly.
